Maximum difference-3 pairs: the numbers split by residues mod 3 into paths of lengths \(14,13,13\).  
So max disjoint diff-3 pairs is
\[
\left\lfloor\frac{14}{2}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{13}{2}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{13}{2}\right\rfloor
=7+6+6=19.
\]
This is attainable, leaving \(2\) and \(3\) as a difference-1 pair. Thus the total sum is
\[
19\cdot 3+1\cdot 1=58.
\]

\boxed{58}
